jobs.tierReason: make the owner-gate memory verdict a trend, not first/last single samples
jobs.prompt:
FILE ACCESS: your declared outputs are readable. Train 8 soak gate: the 10-minute run showed RSS oscillating 94-262 MB with a flat browser heap and no monotonic trend (V8 keeps a high-water mark after a deep build and GC later), so first-sample-to-last-sample growth is a coin flip and can label a flat server a leak. Make the memory verdict a trend over the steady-state samples.

In tools/watch-soak.mjs summarizeSoak:
- Keep the existing first/last/average/slope fields for serverRssKb and pageHeapBytes.
- Add steady-state memory stats: drop the first 2 samples (warm-up: page load and the first build), then baseline = median of the first 3 remaining rss samples and tail = median of the last 3 remaining rss samples. rssGrowth = round(tail - baseline); memoryOk uses this rssGrowth <= RSS_GROWTH_KB_MAX (65536 KB) instead of last-first. Do the same for the browser heap with HEAP_GROWTH_BYTES_MAX (2 MB) using medians. If there are too few samples for 3+3, fall back to last-first over the samples that exist (short --seconds runs must still work).
- Report the baseline/tail/growth values in the memory object (e.g. serverRssKb.steadyBaselineKb, steadyTailKb, steadyGrowthKb; pageHeapBytes analogous) and use them in the leak reason text. Keep the verdict/exit behavior and the CPU metric unchanged.
- Keep monotonic Growth checks for connections/watchers unchanged.

Tests in tests/command-center-soak.test.mjs: export summarizeSoak if needed and add cases: (a) samples with a flat RSS around 100 MB and one 260 MB spike in the last sample plus a 95 MB first sample -> verdict flat (median ignores the spike); (b) a steady climb (100,110,...,160) with the tail median clearly above the baseline -> leak with the memory reason; (c) a short 4-sample run still yields a verdict. Keep the short-soak fixture test green.

Verify: node --import ./tests/_isolate-config.mjs --test tests/command-center-soak.test.mjs tests/command-center-live-latency.test.mjs -> all pass.
